outcomes.outcome: the forwarding rule sends every facility and severity to the target over TLS with the node's certificate, key and CA, validating the server's certificate
the target is pinned in /etc/hosts when its IP is given
a line logged on the node reaches the remote TLS log server, under the node's name
a changed forwarding rule is restored by the next agent run, which restarts rsyslog once
with forward_auth_log, rsyslog accepts the configuration and starts with no configuration error, on Ubuntu 24.04 and on RHEL 9.5 with the rsyslog the class installs there (local change
with forward_auth_log, a line written to /var/log/auth.log reaches the remote TLS log server through the auth.log input
forward_auth_log, check_names and a failover target render their rules (auth.log read and forwarded on its own ruleset, the peer name enforced, a failover action only while the first is suspended)
forwarding switches to the failover target while the first target is suspended
